translation: By the Dawn
And ten nights
And the Even and the Odd
And the night when it departeth

arabic: هَل فى ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِذى حِجرٍ
transliteration: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin
translation: There surely is an oath for thinking man

arabic: أَلَم تَرَ كَيفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعادٍ
transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin
translation: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad
With many-columned Iram

arabic: الَّتى لَم يُخلَق مِثلُها فِى البِلٰدِ
transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi
translation: The like of which was not created in the lands
And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley
And with Pharaoh, firm of might
Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands
And multiplied iniquity therein
Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment
Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful

arabic: فَأَمَّا الإِنسٰنُ إِذا مَا ابتَلىٰهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقولُ رَبّى أَكرَمَنِ
transliteration: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani
translation: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me

arabic: وَأَمّا إِذا مَا ابتَلىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيهِ رِزقَهُ فَيَقولُ رَبّى أَهٰنَنِ
transliteration: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani
translation: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me
Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
And urge not on the feeding of the poor
And ye devour heritages with devouring greed
And love wealth with abounding love

arabic: كَلّا إِذا دُكَّتِ الأَرضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
transliteration: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan
translation: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding
And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank

arabic: وَجِا۟يءَ يَومَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَومَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الإِنسٰنُ وَأَنّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكرىٰ
transliteration: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra
translation: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)
He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life
None punisheth as He will punish on that day
None bindeth as He then will bind
But ah! thou soul at peace
Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure
Enter thou among My bondmen
Enter thou My Garden
